publicStatus.headline: Historical market trends are not evidence-ready
publicStatus.summary: Kitletics will not publish “how running shoes have changed” charts until release-year coverage, per-year samples, brand diversity, and (for price) launch/MSRP fields meet published thresholds. Current catalog specs describe today’s models — they are not a backfilled history.
